source.description: Fast repository policy, documentation, engineering, and public-source contract checks.

core.description: Realtime Server and Project Peer automated tests. Requires locked dependencies to be installed.

launcher.description: Launcher Runtime loader, Launcher Core, and privacy-safe diagnostics bundle tests. Requires .NET 10 SDK for C# tests.

all-local.description: All ordinary source/core/launcher checks that can run from a prepared source checkout without Unity or a packaged release tree.

authority-chaos.description: Deterministic multi-seed realtime authority/recovery stress lane. CI owns process setup and evidence collection.

steps.reason: The workflow owns the short-lease server lifecycle, deterministic seed matrix, evidence verification, and artifact upload.

unity.description: Unity EditMode and real-server E2E lane.

steps.reason: Unity execution depends on the supported Editor and CI/license environment; Test Lab must not report it passed without that evidence.

release.description: Validate a fully staged release candidate tree. This is not a fresh-source-checkout test.

steps.reason: Exact published ZIP/hash/Windows validation has environment and artifact prerequisites beyond the generic source runner.

field.description: Physical multi-PC Windows validation. It can be planned here but cannot be satisfied by a local script or CI substitute.

steps.reason: Run the release-specific physical Host/Guest scenarios required by the current field gate and record exact evidence separately.
